t.eng-ummmuhammad: When the sky has split [open]
And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
And when the earth has been extended
And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحࣰ ا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
ayahs.translit: Ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it
Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand

ayahs.arabic: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابࣰ ا يَسِيرࣰ ا

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He will be judged with an easy account
And return to his people in happiness

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
ayahs.translit: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu waraa thahrihi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But as for he who is given his record behind his back
He will cry out for destruction
And [enter to] burn in a Blaze
Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness
Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah]

ayahs.arabic: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing
So I swear by the twilight glow
And [by] the night and what it envelops
And [by] the moon when it becomes full
[That] you will surely experience state after state
So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
ayahs.translit: Waitha quria AAalayhimu alquranu la yasjudoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]
But those who have disbelieved deny
And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves
So give them tidings of a painful punishment

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
ayahs.translit: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted
